{{Quote|Who were those guys? I've never seen stormtroopers like those.''"<br />"''Those were storm commandos. They're elite soldiers responsible for carrying out special operations against the rebellion.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]]|<ref name="RSIII">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref>}}
The '''Storm Commandos''', also known as '''Imperial Commandos''', '''Shadow Scouts''' and '''infiltration stormtroopers''', were an elite variant of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]'s [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] trained to perform covert [[Commando/Legends|commando]] assaults, precision strikes, and sabotage operations or to subdue insurrections on Imperial-held [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. They also served as second-wave attackers in the battlefield, tasked with holding territory won by the first wave.

==Organization==
[[File:Stormtrooper_Commando.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A storm commando variant in white armor]]
These commando [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] were created with the intention of performing specific tasks that regular soldiers were incapable of accomplishing.<ref name="RoE:TRSH">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref> As such, they were considered an elite unit within the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] and operated within small forces with an emphasis on stealth as well as covert operations over brute force. Storm Commandos were trained to perform covert assaults, precision strikes, and sabotage operations against enemy forces. They were typically deployed into squads that consisted between three to six commandos. They were normally deployed on operations against enemy leaders ranging from capture missions as well as destroying any important facilities used by their foes.<ref name="RES">''[[Rebellion Era Sourcebook]]''</ref> They were even known to take part in assassination missions against a target.<ref name="TFUCG">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

Ultimately, the Storm Commandos were created in response to the effectiveness of guerrilla tactics used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. As such, they were trained to make use of the tactics and use them against Rebel forces. When formed, their ranks consisted of only the best and finest members of the Stormtrooper Corps. The aim of the unit meant that they were experts in guerrilla tactics and had a reputation for ferociousness in combat that exceeded those of other divisions of stormtroopers, and were often used to put down insurrections or revolutions near Rebel hotbeds. Storm commandos were trained especially for counter-insurgency missions with a priority placed on Rebel targets and were often involved in missions such as siege breaking, sabotage, extractions and even in [[Base Delta Zero/Legends|Base Delta Zero]] operations against hard targets.<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> Other missions involved causing uprisings on target systems against governments that were hostile to the Empire. In addition, they also were used against uprisings that were within Imperial control. To further their skills, each commando was an expert pilot and was quite capable in operating vehicles.<ref name="TFUCG" />

[[File:StormCommandoCaptain-TotC.png|thumb|right|250px|A storm commando captain overlooks a battlefield]]
A unit of Storm Commandos could range from 4 to 40 commandos in strength, divided into four equal parts. The first were standard commandos trained and equipped as line units. The second were assault specialists with additional training on how to operate vehicle and [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] blasters. The third were designated saboteurs and particularly resourceful even for Storm Commandos, given extra training in stealth, demolition and countering security systems. The last part were dedicated tech units meant to repair (or jury-rig) a wide array of technology, often assisting saboteurs.<ref name="GG9" /><ref name="RoE:TRSH" />

Storm Commandos, when not assigned to a specific mission, would operate in specific sectors. These Commandos were granted some autonomy and usually saw action against separated rebel forces and had directive from COMPNOR to suppress and enforce imperial policies on both civilian and military personnel alike.

Members of the Rebel Alliance [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|SpecForce]] had several terms for storm commandos, including '''shadowmen''', '''shadows''', and '''black hats'''.<ref name="RoE:TRSH" />

==History==
===Development===
{{Quote|I formed the storm commandos and led them in their early missions. It was those successes that put us in a position to unleash a biological weapon, the Candorian plague, on Dentaal. We were just following orders. That was the last order I took from the Empire. I defected to the Alliance, but I'll be paying my debt to Dentaal until the day I die.|Crix Madine, ''Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide''|<ref name="Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>}}
[[File:StormCommandos-RECG.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Storm commandos with [[All Terrain Personal Transport/Legends|AT-PT]] cover]]
Storm commandos were seen in action as early as [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. In the months following the [[Declaration of a New Order]], a group of storm commandos was affected to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] during the [[Atoan insurgency]], under command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Shale (human)|Shale]]. When Shale betrayed the Empire, his commandos [[Mutiny in the Atoan system|mutinied]] and tried to kill Vader.<ref name="DV&tLC">''[[Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Lost Command]]''</ref>

The development of the storm commandos was overseen by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Tanniel]] in response to the guerrilla tactics of the Rebel Alliance during the early days of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Tanniel placed [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] in charge of the first unit of storm commandos deployed. Despite Madine's later defection to the Alliance, the commando training program continued. Only the best Imperial stormtroopers received this training. By the end of the war, commandos were only available in limited numbers.

===Galactic Civil War===
[[File:StormCommandos.jpg|thumb|right|150px|A storm commando]]
Storm commandos, along with representatives from every specialized stormtrooper corps, were assigned to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] personal [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]].<ref name="GG3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref> Important tasks of the commandos included acquiring new technology for the Empire by capturing scientists. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], they engineered the [[Defense of Ralltiir|Battle of Ralltiir]] to abduct a group of scientists. Rebel pilot [[Sarkli]] defected from the Alliance during this battle; he later became a Captain within the Storm Commandos.<ref name="RSIII" /> After the destruction of the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] ordered a renewed offensive against the Rebel threat which was spearheaded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Victor Strang]] who led a detachment of Imperial Storm Commandos onboard the [[Conqueror (superlaser)|''Conqueror'']]. This special forces team came into conflict with the Rebel Alliance's [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]].<ref name="TC">{{SWGTCG|set=Threat of the Conqueror|scenario=Dark Side campaign}}</ref>

They were also sometimes tasked with capturing defectors such as [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]], who [[Mission to Dantooine|evaded]] them on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] with the help of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="X-wing Rogue Leader">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing: Rogue Leader]]''</ref>

Captain Sarkli flew a modified escort carrier with an improved hyperdrive, in which he abducted Rebel scientists during the [[Raid at Bakura]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. He later fled to [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], where [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] shot his craft down, beginning a [[Battle of Geonosis (Galactic Civil War)|battle]] in orbit and on the surface of the planet.<ref name="RSIII" /> While piloting an [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing]] during the [[Mission to Destrillion]], Antilles encountered and destroyed a carrier containing about 24 TIE Hunters. The commandos' [[Imperial escort carrier (storm commando)|Imperial escort carriers]] guarded the [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]] [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|construction yards]], and fought during the [[Fondor shipyard assault]].<ref name="RSIII" />

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Captain Sarkli was present on the [[Death Star II/Legends|Second Death Star]] during [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor Palpatine's]] visit.<ref name="Return of the Jedi">{{Film|VI}}</ref> He was reassigned from the Death Star to the shield bunker on Endor, commanding a storm commando sentry unit. During the Battle of Endor, he attempted to block Han Solo's escape from the burning bunker. Firing his rifle, Sarkli backed away from Solo all the way to the entrance. He received a fatal wound from Solo's blaster and fell to the floor, dead. His body was destroyed when the shield bunker exploded.

===Post-Endor Period===
[[File:LukefightsCommandos.jpg|thumb|left|Luke Skywalker fighting storm commandos on Corellia]]
One week after the Battle of Endor, a force of storm commandos led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Weir/Legends|Weir]] attacked [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] from their base on [[Tralus/Legends|Tralus]]. The attack was meant to instill fear upon the Corellian population, despite the defeat of the Galactic Empire and the death of the Emperor at the Battle of Endor, that there was still an Imperial presence in the system. Weir discovered a small Rebel Alliance force consisting of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] pilots [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]], and [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]], as well as [[Ten Numb/Legends|Ten Numb]] of [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]]. Despite not capturing the Rebel forces, Weir ordered his commandos to withdraw to awaiting transport vessels. Ten Numb was captured personally by Weir while withdrawing and taken back to Tralus.

Ten Numb was tortured by General Weir until he broke, giving the General the information he required. The [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] later died from injuries sustained as part of the interrogation. Luke Skywalker and Rogue Squadron found the hidden Imperial base on Tralus with the help of [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Leyli]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. Weir ordered his storm commandos to attack the Rebels while he escaped the planet in a TIE Interceptor. Weir's [[Sunspot Squadron]] was scrambled in response to an attack by Wedge Antilles and Tycho Celchu in stolen TIE Fighters. Antilles used his TIE Fighter to shoot down Weir. Unable to flee due to injuries sustained in the crash, Weir was arrested by Antilles. Weir was extradited to [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] and interrogated by Rebel officers.<ref name="X-wing Rogue Leader" />

==Equipment and vehicles==
{{Quote|Imperial escort carriers!"<br />"Imperial ''what''?"<br /> "They're not part of the regular Imperial Navy. They're exclusive to the Imperial storm commandos.|[[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] and [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] upon seeing an escort carrier|<ref name="RSIII" />}}
[[File:StormCommando-InstantAdventures.jpg|thumb|left|135px|A storm commando takes aim]]
[[File:ShockStormCommando.jpg|thumb|right|150px|An Imperial storm commando wearing a painted version of [[Imperial shock trooper/Legends|Imperial shock trooper]] armor.]]Their [[Storm Commando armor/Legends|armor]] was based on the [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout trooper's]] light armor, though the black color most commonly seen earned them the nickname "shadow scouts"; it was enhanced with a coating of an advanced polymer called [[Reflec/Legends|reflec]], which deflected light and [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] energy. This made the wearers virtually invisible to all but the most determined of scans.<ref name="RES" /> The armor was designed by [[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Nashiak Llalik]].<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref> To support their mission profile, storm commando armor included a small generator that created a sound-dampening field, a personal shield, numerous concealed weapons, and a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] that a commando could detonate if faced with capture. The storm commandos sometimes wore a different variant of their armor with a helmet that resembled Darth Vader's helmet, as well as red stripes on the shoulder pads, as evidenced by the storm commandos involved in the attempted arrest of [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. They also sometimes wore painted versions of Imperial shock trooper armor.

Storm commandos used a wide assortment of weaponry. The [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]] served as their primary rifle, though they were sometimes known to make use of [[Evasive-226-R]] [[Individual field disruptor/Legends|field disruptors]]. If the situation required, storm commandos could also use the [[Oppressor flamethrower]] and the [[Imperial long-range rocket rifle]].

[[File:Dantooine01.jpg|thumb|left|285x285px|An Imperial storm commando participating in Celchu's arrest.]]
In addition to their standard gear, storm commandos who were part of the assault section carried [[Concussion grenade/Legends|concussion grenades]] and a [[heavy weapon]], the latter of which depended on the commando's choice and mission parameters. For example, in operations which required speed, a single-trooper [[Light repeating blaster/Legends|light repeating blaster]] or [[Grenade launcher/Legends|grenade launcher]] allowed for a measure of firepower and mobility. For members of the saboteur team, their extra gear were satchels of [[Detonite/Legends|detonite]], (usually three for every other trooper) and occasionally [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] and [[thermal well]]s. Tech team members carried sophisticated communication gear, tool kits, and computer probes in addition to their normal weaponry.<ref name="GG9" /><ref name="RoE:TRSH" />

Storm commandos used modified [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bikes]]<ref name="TFUCG" /> to aid them in missions of deep infiltration. These missions usually involved uncovering plots and discovering deadly secrets that could be used to force enemies to cooperate. Their [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]] were designed for silence and speed, with a trideflective energy shield that prevented detection.

According to some reports, certain Storm Commando units (such as the [[DeathWhispers]]), made use of Imperial war droids such as the [[ZQ Infantry Support Unit|ZQ infantry droid]] long after they were supposedly phased out of general use by the Imperial military.<ref name="Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref>

Storm commandos were also trained to fly commando-exclusive [[TIE/hu "Hunter" Multi-Role Starfighter|TIE Hunters]], generally operating from Imperial escort [[Carrier/Legends|carriers]] under their direct command and control.<ref name="RSIII" /> In addition, in certain special forces operations, they made use of [[Imperial Troop Drop Pod]]s.

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]'', the [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] from Captain Sarkli's escort carrier on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] contain soldiers in normal white [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] armor. These were storm commandos in standard stormtrooper armor.
